prompt: A frail young cleric in a pale linen habit and golden stole has collapsed onto her knees on a dark battlefield at dusk, mortally wounded, her body slumping and her head falling back. A column of warm gold-white holy light pours upward out of her chest and arcs sideways toward two wounded soldiers kneeling beside her on the right, both fully visible from head to knee; the light washes over them and their bodies brighten as their wounds close. The only source of light in the scene is this gold-white soul-light streaming from her chest. The background is a dim, smoke-grey ruined field under a darkening sky.

A frail cleric in a white linen habit lies sprawled and dying, fallen backward onto dark stone, arms fallen open to either side in serene cruciform surrender, face calm and at peace, eyes closed. A vertical column of radiant gold-white motes and glowing embers streams steadily upward out of her heart into the darkness above, her life ascending. The only source of light is this rising gold-white soul-light. The background is a shadowed stone chapel floor.

A frail cleric in a pale linen habit lunges forward and falls across a crouching wounded soldier to shield him, taking a long iron spear buried through her own back, her body bent over his in the instant of impact. From the spear wound a burst of gold-white holy healing light erupts forward and washes over the soldier beneath her, knitting his wounds as she dies for him. Both figures fully visible, the same size. The only source of light is the gold-white burst between their bodies. The background is a dim battlefield at dusk.
